$comment: When each credential set last changed — dates only, never what it changed to. `pnpm env:drift` compares Vercel production's `updatedAt` against these and refuses a release cut when a governed variable is older. A rotation entry names the variables it governs: `names` are rows in scripts/env-manifest.ts, `platform` are values the deployment holds that no app code reads (the provider's own runtime consumes them), `prefixes` cover a family. Adding a set is one reviewed entry; moving a date to silence a red run is not a rotation.

rotations.why: The Neon account moved on 2026-11-24 and every Neon-derived value was re-sourced by hand on 2026-11-26 — the connection strings, the auth service, the API key and the branch name had been stale since 2026-10-30.
